gloss: a man breaking down in tears

definitions.gloss: a man weeping; a man breaking down in tears
definitions.explanation: Weeping by a man who would not normally cry, overcome by strong emotion such as joy, grief, or relief. Usually sympathetic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{男泣|おとこな}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The manager broke down in tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男泣|おとこな}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泣|な}いた→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: The moment their victory was settled, the players broke down and wept.

examples.japanese: ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強気|つよき}→強気：04064_tsuyoki⟧な⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧はばからず{男泣|おとこな}き⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My usually tough father wept openly at his daughter's wedding, not caring who saw.

notes:
⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ + {泣|な}き (crying). Built on the old idea that men do not cry, so it stresses how deeply moved the man was.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男泣|おとこな}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: (of a man) to break down in tears
- {男泣|おとこな}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: to weep openly, overcome
- ⟦{人目|ひとめ}→人目：17973_hitome⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧はばからず{男泣|おとこな}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to weep openly in front of others

USAGE:
Common in sports reporting. It is the man's tears that are remarkable, so it is not used of women; the general words are ⟦{号泣|ごうきゅう}→号泣：15038_goukyuu⟧ (wailing) and ⟦{泣|な}き{崩|くず}れる→泣き崩れる：13342_nakikuzureru⟧ (to break down crying).
